consent.title: AI ideas to start the conversation?
consent.what: To suggest ideas, we send an excerpt of your prompt answers and interests, without your first name, contact details or photos.
consent.other: The other person's answers are only sent if they turned this option on too.
consent.where: The excerpt goes to Anthropic (Claude AI), in the United States. Epilove keeps neither the excerpt nor the ideas.
consent.never: Nothing is ever sent on your behalf: you pick an idea, edit it, and send it.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time in Notification settings, under “In conversations”.
